At the same time, it was also announced that this song will be released digitally. This movie is a live-action adaptation of Shimofuri Myojo Seiya's semi-autobiographical novel ``A Sketch that Changed My Life'' starring Naniwa Danshi Kazuya Ohashi. articles.translatedExcerpt: The Gospellers are currently holding a nationwide tour <Gospelerszaka Tour 2026 “UNIVER5OUL”>. On October 25th, at the Tachikawa Stage Garden performance in Tokyo, they announced to their fans that the number of live performances under the name ``Gospelerszaka Tour'' had reached 1,000 in total. This was announced by member Murakami during the MC at the beginning of the performance. With a drum roll in the background, they announced, ``The Gospeller's Hill Tour, which started on January 5, 1996, has celebrated its 1000th performance.'' They shared their joy with the fans by performing call and response calls of "1000!" and "1000!" articles.translatedTitle: FLYING KIDS performs power play on Radio Takasaki with their first distributed single “Heiligenstadt no Will” under the new system
articles.translatedExcerpt: FLYING KIDS, who welcomed new member Kaika (Vo/Kb) in the spring of 2026 and made a new start with eight members, will release a new digital single "Heiligenstadt no Will" on November 4th (Wednesday). Prior to this, the song was selected to be featured on Radio Takasaki's ``WEEKLY POWER PLAY.'' This work, which will be released on November 4th (Wednesday), is the first song released by the new group FLYING KIDS. It's a mellow funk number with impressive twin vocals by Takashi Hamasaki and Kaika, singing about the determination to quietly overcome sadness and move forward. The title of the song is an homage to Beethoven's ``Heiligenstadt Testament,'' in which he wrote his determination to live with music despite his suffering, as he was losing his hearing. Changes that occur in everyday life that we thought would continue for granted, and the sadness that comes with it...

articles.translatedTitle: Risa Junna holds a winter concert with talented musicians
articles.translatedExcerpt: Risa Junna's winter concert <Risa Junna Concert 2026 Christmas Time in GRACE> will be held in Tokyo on November 24th (Tuesday) and in Osaka on December 24th (Thursday). Pianist Toshitaka Shibata, who also serves as Maki Daiguro's tour band master, will be joined by Atsuki Yoshida (violin), Kanato Iijima (cello), and Kan (performer), who are active in a wide range of music scenes across genres, and a special Christmas time will be held with the unique sound woven by these four people and Risa Junna's clear singing voice. articles.translatedTitle: Ado, beloved SSW Yoeko, newly written song “Patient A” surprise distribution & MV release
articles.translatedExcerpt: Ado released his new song ``Patient A'' on his 24th birthday today. This song is a new song written by singer-songwriter Yoeko, who has been known as an influence on Ado for some time. The lyrics unfold in a way that depicts the world as a theater troupe and himself as someone playing a role within it, and even though he smiles on the outside, the protagonist repeats ``Akanbe'' in his heart. The song is said to be a powerful yet resonant song, with words that ironically describe his frustration with the role he has been given and his opposition to those around him. Along with the distribution, a music video was also released. This work, with illustrations by manga artist Tomo Koshitsu and video by Cymo, depicts the story of Ado, a student who belongs to Niconico High School's drama club, and her desire to do something ``Akanbe'' to the world. The days when it seems like the people around you are picking on you, the main tone is monochrome...

articles.translatedExcerpt: Furukawa Yutaka has announced that he will hold the ``Furukawa Yutaka Complete Works'' as the encore performance of ``National Tour 2026 ``Zekkei'''' at Ogikubo TOP BEAT CLUB in Tokyo on January 22, 2027. This performance will be held in two parts: acoustic and band set. In the first part, they performed an acoustic live performance with Fox Capture Plan's Merten providing keyboard support. As the performance title suggests, ``Furukawa Yutaka Complete Works'', the content will allow you to enjoy various full Kawa Yutaka performances throughout his career. articles.title: STARGLOW、HEARTSTEEL「Live My Life」をカバー。レコーディング映像公開も
articles.excerpt: STARGLOWのTAIKI、KANON、ADAMが、Riot Gamesの人気ゲーム『リーグ・オブ・レジェンド（LoL）』から誕生したバーチャルアーティストグループ・HEARTSTEELの楽曲「Live My Life」をカバーし、そのパフォーマンスを収めた映像を公開した。 「Live My Life」は、明るく爽やかなサウンドと自分らしく自由に生きるというメッセージが印象的な楽曲。今回公開された映像では、TAIKI、KANON、ADAMの3人が本作のレコーディングに臨む様子を収録しており、楽曲の持つ軽やかな魅力とともに、3人の歌声と自然体の姿も楽しめる映像になっているという。 STARGLOWは、10月26日に先行配信シングル「Slam Dunk」、11月18日には1stアルバム『Aurora』のリリ…
articles.translatedTitle: STARGLOW covers HEARTSTEEL's "Live My Life". Recording video released
articles.translatedExcerpt: STARGLOW's TAIKI, KANON, and ADAM covered the song "Live My Life" by HEARTSTEEL, a virtual artist group born from Riot Games' popular game "League of Legends (LoL)," and released a video of their performance. "Live My Life" is a song with a bright and refreshing sound and an impressive message of living freely in your own way. The video released this time shows TAIKI, KANON, and ADAM recording this work, and the video allows you to enjoy the light and airy charm of the song, as well as the singing voices and natural appearances of the three members. STARGLOW will release the pre-release single “Slam Dunk” on October 26th, and the release of their first album “Aurora” on November 18th.

articles.translatedExcerpt: Miliyah Kato has announced that she will release her new song ``Aitai'' on November 2, 2026. Today, she made a surprise announcement and performed the song for the first time at the opening day performance of Miliyah Kato LOST IN LOVE TOUR 2026, her first national tour in about three years, held at Kure Shinkin Bank Hall in Hiroshima. This song is a new interpretation of "Aitai", which was included in the album "Ring" released in 2009, after 17 years. articles.translatedTitle: Josiah Queen releases new AL with 14 songs
articles.translatedExcerpt: Josiah Queen released his new album "Damascus Road" on Friday, October 23, 2026. This work, which includes a total of 14 songs, focuses on the moment when an encounter with God changes your life, the hope found in weakness, and the journey toward unwavering faith. The album's title, ``Damascus Road,'' comes from the Biblical story of Saul's encounter with Jesus, which changed his life forever. This work depicts more than just a celebration of faith. A spiritual journey in which one faces hesitation and inner conflict, surrenders to oneself, accepts change, and begins a new path. Through honest songwriting rooted in personal experience and accessible folk-derived melodies, it resonates with people of faith as well as listeners searching for meaning and hope in life.

Driven from within The music video, directed by Hideyuki Tanaka, centers on the two cast members running through various locations with all their might, interweaving impressive singing and performance scenes by the two Yuzu members.

articles.translatedExcerpt: Umiarashi released his first EP “HMU,AS I AIR” on Wednesday, October 21, 2026. This work includes a total of 7 songs with a rich variety, including ``Otona na ni Yuku'', which is a bold band arrangement of songs performed by Vo./Gt. Go Tanaka using a looper, ``Exploration Party's Night Song'', ``Kudaranae'', which he created with his former support members, and ``Daibakasha'', which was his first composition as Umiarashi. Starting with the lead single ``Aoi no Ao'', this album features technical and passionate performances that give a sense of each member's career path, as well as experimental arrangements. articles.translatedTitle: GLAY's latest album "Waiting for the reason to travel" has been released. Official interview with leader TAKURO also released
articles.translatedExcerpt: GLAY released their first new album in two years, ``Waiting for the reason to travel,'' on October 21st. This work, which is the 18th album in total, is a work that condenses the thoughts of GLAY as the "next move" presented after running through the 30th anniversary year. Up until now, the traditional style was to produce new songs, release the sound source, and perform the completed songs on tour. However, leader TAKURO, who completed the 30th anniversary, had a strong desire to "value GLAY and myself more in the rapidly changing times. Let's once question what we took for granted." So for this album, just like in the early days of the band's formation, they write songs, work them out in the studio, and then deliver them live to their fans. The album was completed with a return to basics approach of turning the polished songs into sound sources and releasing them into the world.

articles.translatedExcerpt: N Feni released a new song “Vintage Mansion” on October 21, 2026. "Vintage Mansion" is a song written, composed, arranged, and produced by Feni himself. Looking at the city in the night breeze, feeling the sadness of seeing the lights of other people's lives, the story depicts a man's feelings wavering between his yearning to live there someday and his desire to run out the moment it comes true. Humor and irony are imbued with life-like words such as ``somen noodles in the summer and hot pot in the winter,'' while the ending is full of life-sized reality as he envisions a future where he can spend time with his loved ones. The music video for "Vintage Mansion" directed by Hiraki has also been released. Set in the streets of Tainan, Taiwan, the film depicts daily life in a nostalgic way while touring pastel-colored walls and buildings lined with cutely decorated fences called "iron window flowers."

The Hitsuji Literature Award is a collaboration between Hitsuji Literature and monogatary.com, the novel posting site that produced YOASOBI. This work, ``Saturday Night Theater,'' is a film adaptation of the short story ``Saturday Night Theater'' (written by Yukiharu), which won the grand prize out of over 1,000 works at the second edition of the same award. The movie to be released this time is based on the same work, which was inspired by the song ``Beyond the Night'' by Hitsuji Bungaku, and adds original elements and new interpretations unique to the movie. articles.translatedExcerpt: In January 2025, when it was announced that Dance Hall Crashers would reunite for the first time in 21 years, there were quite a few fans here in Japan who erupted with joy, proving once again the deep-rooted popularity of Dance Hall Crashers in Japan. Dance Hall Crashers is a ska-punk band formed in Berkeley, California in 1989. The band was originally started as a side project by Tim Armstrong and Matt Freeman, who were members of Operation Ivy, a band that pioneered ska-punk/ska-core, but when they decided to concentrate on their newly started Rancid, they re-emerged as a five-piece group fronted by two singers, Elyse Rogers and Karina Deniké.

articles.title: Rachel Chinouriri、新ALリリース
articles.excerpt: Rachel Chinouririが2026年10月16日(金)にニューアルバム『I think I spoke too soon』をリリースした。 全12曲、約40分にわたる本作は、ダンスフロアを彩るシンセポップの華やかさと、彼女ならではの繊細で率直なインディーポップを融合させた意欲作。20代前半から半ばにかけて経験する自己認識の変化、恋愛の混乱、そして大人になることの難しさを描いたアルバムとなっている。 サウンド面では、躍動感のあるシンセサイザー、ダンサブルなビート、オルタナティブロックの質感を融合。デビュー作で確立した親密なインディーポップの魅力を保ちながら、より洗練されたポップサウンドへと表現の幅を広げている。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/432879…
articles.translatedTitle: Rachel Chinouriri, new AL release
articles.translatedExcerpt: Rachel Chinouriri released her new album ``I think I spoke too soon'' on Friday, October 16, 2026. This 12-song, approximately 40-minute album is an ambitious work that combines the glamor of dance floor synth pop with her signature delicate and frank indie pop. The album depicts the changes in self-perception, the confusion in love, and the difficulty of becoming an adult that people experience in their early to mid-20s. In terms of sound, it combines dynamic synthesizers, danceable beats, and alternative rock textures. While maintaining the intimate indie pop charm established in their debut album, they have expanded their range of expression to a more sophisticated pop sound. Release information https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/432879…
